Definition: probably akin to G3173; length (literally or figuratively):--length.
BiblicalUsage: Mekos is length, and it stretches both ways, from the measure of a city to the measure of God's love. Ephesians 3:18 prays that believers may comprehend the breadth and length and depth and height of Christ's love, and Revelation 21:16 measures the new Jerusalem, its length as large as its breadth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the love of Christ is the one length no reed can measure, and the city built on it is foursquare and sure.
